references.name: downstream-aerial
references.use: Ordinary visual reference only;not redistributed as a model texture.
references.observed: Ordinary aerial inspected:two long powerhouse blocks downstream/north of the angular concrete gravity wall,three broad spillway chutes with paired gate bays and red structural heads,two extensive rock-fill embankments continuing beyond the central concrete core,crest service road and gantry cranes,open tailrace branches and separate downstream access bridge/substations. Exact water/machinery/facade levels and turbine inventory are picture-based estimates. No copied lettering,logos,people,vehicles or fluid-operation claim.
